about_the_game:
Buy, Battle, Repeat!

Remember the golden age of turn-based strategy? Knight's Errand distills that experience into fast, 30-minute tournament runs. No the sprawling campaigns and save-scumming, only what truly matters: your tactical skill.

The core loop is simple and addictive: Shop → Battle → Shop. You are the commander on a classic hexagonal battlefield. Every decision is yours, and every choice is final. Recruit new units, upgrade your squads, and immediately test your evolving army against the "ghosts" of other players' creations.

With five lives for your entire tournament run, mistakes will cost you, but a single tactical blunder won't end your journey. It's the perfect balance of high-stakes tension and the freedom to dare.

Key Features

  • Classic Tactical Combat: Engage in turn-based battles with stacks of units on a hexagonal grid.

  • Asynchronous Multiplayer: Fight against "ghost" armies of other players at any time. No waiting for an opponent!

  • Pure Gameplay, No Fluff: The entire experience is focused on what matters most: assembling your army and fighting battles.

  • Roguelike Mechanics: With a limited number of lives per run, every decision is final.

  • Rich Strategic Variety: Choose from several factions, each with unique units and abilities. Discover new strategies with heroes who have their own progression and items.

  • Unique Morale & Critical Hit Systems: Experience a fresh approach to tactical combat with innovative morale and critical hit systems.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 2 GHz
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 256mb Video Memory, capable of OpenGL 2.0+ support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Gather your army. Defeat other players' avatars. Claim the champion's title. Knight's Errand is a concentrated dose of tactical nostalgia, designed for quick and intense sessions. Pure tactics, no filler.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Ukrainian
